title: BillingBalanceReadResult
description: billing.balance-read-result@1: answers of billing.balance.read on OpenVibe.Billing. GET /api/v1/balances/:subject → billing.balance@1; GET /api/v1/transactions?subject=&limit=&cursor= → { transactions, next_cursor } (newest first, at most 200 a page; subject is required); GET /api/v1/transactions/:id → { transaction, reversed_by } (ids of the transactions that reverse it).
